{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the first few rows of revenue to confirm it's string with commas
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if there's any other sentinel value in revenue
print(f"Unique revenue values excluding QA: {sales[~(sales['revenue'] == 999999.99)]['revenue'].unique()}")"}
